doc:
Instrument scope the OPENING surface hands to the sheet.

The row list branches on the CURRENT instrument's `inst_type`
(`orchestration::list_assembly` — SPOT/MARGIN show the quote-ccy balance,
SWAP/FUTURES only when positive, OPTION never; and at L3/L4 SPOT/MARGIN take the
spot list while everything else takes the future list). Without a scope that
`inst_type` comes from the persisted "last biz"
(`TradeBizCache::load_last_biz`), whose only writer is the trade page's
instrument load (`main_page_manager::persist_current_instrument`). The OPTION
line never writes it — `ensure_option_shell_ready` just loads the OPTION biz
metadata — so the sheet opened from an option surface branched on whatever
spot/contract pair the user visited last (device: an option page showing the
SPOT list, complete with a "USDT balance" row native explicitly excludes for
options).

Fixing that by writing OPTION into the global cache was rejected: that key is
also read by the trade-record default pair filter
(`aggregate_records_manager`), the cold-start biz restore
(`main_page_manager::cached_instrument_request`) and the order / history list
"current pair" gates — none of which are in scope here.

Native has the same concept for "open this sheet for a specific instrument":
`BizInfoConfig.CustomArgsBizConfig(instType, instId)` ("memory only"), the
sibling of the `DefaultBizConfig` cache read the sheet uses today.

All three fields are plain identity forwarded by the host. Resolution order is
`inst_id` → `inst_family` → type-only.

name: refresh_last_price

ISSUE #1 (2026-07-09) — sync `state.last_price` from the parent session's
InstContext `ticker.last` ON DEMAND. Replaces the removed per-tick ticker
mirror (which marked the whole form State dirty on every WS push → a full

`manager.pre_check` last-price arg, the market max-size USD cap) but run on
the shared state snapshot with no session handle, so the value must live in

+ once on start / resume — NEVER per ticker push, so it never re-creates the
idle render burst. Mirror of `PureSpotLimitInteractor::refresh_last_price`
(`spot_limit_interactor.rs:3686`). Only overwrites on a live value so a
transient empty ticker read cannot clobber a good price (`state.last_price`
is `String` here, not spot-limit's `Option<String>`); `modify_state` no-ops
on an unchanged value.

fields.name: reduce_only
fields.doc:
V1 reduce-only checkbox (`tvReduce`) — host-pushed via `set_reduce_only`
(mirrors `viewModel.isReduceOnly()`). Two effects, both wired:
(1) drives the margin-available convertor's `is_reduce` ccy branch
(`derive_margin_available`); and
(2) flips the server-computed `available` — `set_reduce_only` re-fetches
max-avail and `into_request` carries `is_reduce_only` (V1
AbsMarginTradePanelPresenter:196 reduceOnly + B2 cross-layer rule).
`is_base_on_position_debt` stays false: V1 getBaseOnPositionDebt
returns false for the MP order type (:227-240).

fields.name: quote_amount_decimal_digits
fields.doc:
BUY amount-box precision -- `IndexConfig.quoteDig`, the field native pushes onto
`amtInputView.setMaxDecimal` (`MarginMpFragment.initAmtInput` kt:97-105).

A SEPARATE field from [`Self::quote_decimal_digits`] on purpose: that one is the
`tick_sz` fractional count (PRICE precision) and the host also feeds it to
`activePriceInput.setMaxDecimal` (`PureMarginMpFragment.kt:1403`), which is correct
and must not move. `0` = not resolved yet (cold index config), and the host then
keeps using `quote_decimal_digits` exactly as before.

fields.name: price_with_depth_type

Mirror of spot-mp `state.price_with_depth_type` (spot/mp/pure/state.rs:142).
V1 `priceWithDepthSelectView.getCurrentType()`. Pushed by the Kotlin host
via `on_price_with_depth_type_changed`. Drives the rate/spread split in
`on_price_changed` + the price-input label/unit/digit getters. `callback_type`
(String, consumed by execute.rs) is kept in sync from this enum so the
order-input builder stays unchanged.

single-leg fix. The SPOT max-available `available` is side-dependent
(BUY → quote-ccy avail; SELL → base-ccy avail — `spot_types.rs:443-445`).
After a side flip the ROOT #2-retained snapshot belongs to the PRIOR
side; deriving/rendering it against the NEW `side` shows the other side's
value under the wrong ccy label (reversed) or a stale/0 figure. The avail
projection + seekbar percent-calc gate their `Loaded` output on
`balance_side == side`; a mismatch renders `--` (Loading) until the
side-change re-fetch stamps the new side here. Empty until the first
fetch lands.

so the avail projection gate passed the PRIOR coin's snapshot as `Loaded`
→ the row kept showing the previous coin's value AND ccy unit. The
projection + seekbar/market-max gates now also require
`balance_inst == inst_id`; a mismatch renders `--` until the inst-change
re-fetch stamps the new instrument here. Every balance write site sets it.

legal-currency change re-converts the non-empty price to the new fiat instead of leaving
a stale value. Empty until the first projection/set. Internal (not rendered). Writers:
`project_session_instrument_into_state` + `set_input_active_px`.

`get_exchange_rate()` only exposes the CURRENT fiat's rate. Empty until first set.
Internal (not rendered). Writers: same as `price_fiat_iso`.
